title: GNO Vector GC Report
description: Report emitted by `gno vec gc --json`. With `dryRun: true`, `variants` and `bytes` are what a real run would remove and nothing was written. Logical embedding bytes are reported separately from the database file size: deleting rows makes space reusable without shrinking the file.

partitions.description: Every stored vector partition (active, shadow and legacy-keyed).

variants.description: Variants with no live use: collectible (dry run) or removed.

bytes.description: Stored embedding bytes of those variants.

skipped.description: Why the partition was not processed (for example sqlite-vec unavailable for its vector index).

bytes.description: Logical embedding bytes collectible or removed.

legacyContentVectors.description: Legacy `content_vectors` rows; not collected here (`gno cleanup` removes orphaned ones, `gno vec prune` superseded ones).

databaseBytes.description: Size of the main database file on disk in bytes (the WAL file is not included).

freeBytes.description: Free pages SQLite reuses before growing the file.
